title: What Does "Clock It" Mean? Gen Z Slang Explained #shorts
description:
What does clock it mean? She's reading a love note from the boy next door. Then her dad walks out.
• Clock it: to notice something someone is trying to hide (Gen Z slang)
• Example: "He clocked it" = he noticed it right away

Has anyone ever clocked you like this?

Clip: Neighbors (1920)
